title: Adaptive Sequential Change Detection using Mixtures of Predictive Distributions
summary: This paper studies the problem of detecting a change in the distribution of a sequence of independent observations when the post-change distribution is unknown. We propose a novel change detection algorithm, termed Predictive-Mixture CuSum (PM-CuSum), which combines predictive distributions constructed from sliding windows of different lengths within a CuSum recursion. The predictive distributions are aggregated using adaptive weights based on their recent predictive performance.
